name: Singita Sabora Tented Camp
positioning: Light, modern tented camp set in 350,000 acres of protected wilderness in Singita Grumeti, where each suite has its own meditation deck, outdoor sala and private fitness area
best_for: Safari travelers who want a modern take on life under canvas with a front-row seat to the Great Migration
Guests who value privacy in their suite, with a meditation deck, daybeds and an in-room pantry

facts.text: Sabora Tented Camp is set in 350,000 acres of protected wilderness in Singita Grumeti.
The camp's setting gives guests a front-row seat to game viewing that includes the Great Migration.
Singita Grumeti sits adjacent to the Serengeti National Park in Tanzania, within the Serengeti-Mara ecosystem.
The camp's style is a pared-back interpretation of traditional safari style that is light, modern and elegant.
The work of local artisans features throughout the camp.
Each suite includes a private meditation deck and an outdoor sala with daybeds.
Each suite includes a private fitness area.
Each suite includes a lifestyle unit with a curated in-room pantry and dining space.
The tented suites have wide windows that look out over the Serengeti plains, so guests can spot wildlife from the bedroom.
A Guest Deli with baskets and fridges of gourmet treats lets guests pick snacks to enjoy in their suites or at picnic spots around the camp.
Activities include a hot air balloon safari, guided safari walks and a visit to an anti-poaching observation post.
The camp has a swimming pool, offers yoga and fitness, and has a boutique and gallery.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the remote wilderness location requires charter flights.
WhataHotel notes the camp is not available for online booking; reservations are made by contacting WhataHotel.
